name: Naturalisation via Marriage to a Finnish Citizen

qualifying_event.description: Marriage to a Finnish citizen does not grant citizenship automatically. It instead reduces the standard naturalisation residence requirement from 8 years to 5 years.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage or registered-partnership certificate; proof of 5 years' continuous residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be married to, or in a registered partnership with, a Finnish citizen. Gender-neutral -- applies equally to same-sex registered partnerships.

5 years of continuous residence in Finland (reduced from the standard 8-year bar), plus the same financial-resources, identity, and conduct conditions applied to all naturalisation routes since the December 2025 reform.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of continuous residence while married to/partnered with a Finnish citizen.

sources.title: Maahanmuuttovirasto -- FAQ: Finnish Citizenship: reduced 5-year residence requirement for spouses of Finnish citizens

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Finland). Unlike some countries in this dataset with a genuinely gender-restricted marriage route, Finland's is gender-neutral and explicitly extends to registered partnerships. It is a reduced naturalisation threshold (5 years residence vs. the standard 8), not an accelerated automatic grant -- consistent in structure with Bulgaria's Article 13 marriage route documented elsewhere in this dataset. Also carries the same December 2025 financial-resources/identity/conduct conditions as fi_naturalisation.json's standard route.
